phases: Fill the mold with loose soil mix
Stand the yoke up: followers roll up the rails into the scoops
Press the latch handle to free the lever
Pull the lever over to horizontal (pressing)
Raise the lever: piston drops away from the block
Let the latch drop over the head
Tilt lever and yoke onto the eject rollers
Open the lid: it swings onto its counterweights
Push the lever down to eject the block
Lift the block off and stack it
Let the lever rise: piston drops for the next fill
